newsitem.title: CHINA: Japan Industrial Bank moves to Pudong.
newsitem.headline: Japan Industrial Bank moves to Pudong.

text.p: The Industrial Bank of Japan became on Monday the fourth foreign bank to move to Shanghai's economic development zone of Pudong in preparation for doing local Chinese yuan business, a bank announcement said.
"The bank will start on Monday to do foreign currency business in Pudong," the announcement said.

The bank is one of eight foreign banks approved by the central bank to do local currency business in Shanghai on a trial basis, and on the condition they move their local offices to Pudong, east of the Huangpu River from Shanghai's city centre.
Among the eight, three -- Citibank of the United States, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd of Japan and Hong Kong & Shanghai Banking Corp -- have already moved to Pudong.
The central bank's Shanghai branch is working on detailed rules for foreign banks doing local currency business. Foreign bankers say they expect the business to start in April.
